notes: Bands follow the PRD weights with the certainty the prompt asks for (hedged, conditional or sarcastic = speculative). The sarcasm golden is 'ignore' (must not be shown); prompt rule 7 asks for sarcasm as speculative, which the weights put in Low (0.40). items.title: Order replacement chairs if the budget is approved
items.quote: If the board approves the new budget on Tuesday, I'll order the replacement chairs for the studio.
items.note: Conditional promise. 'Tuesday' dates the board vote, not the order, so no due date. 0.30 + 0.05 exact + 0.05 modal = 0.40, Also noticed.

items.title: Maybe cover Felix's Saturday shift
items.quote: I might be able to cover your Saturday shift.
items.note: Hedged offer. As an intention: 0.30 + 0.05 + 0.05 = 0.40, Low. If typed commitment the 'might' penalty gives 0.25 (Ignore), a recall miss; that sensitivity to type is what this item measures.

items.title: Repaint the lobby
items.quote: We should probably repaint the lobby sometime after the holidays.
items.note: Vague timing: 'after the holidays' has no date (prompt rule 3). 0.30 + 0.05 = 0.35, Also noticed.

items.quote: I'll definitely get right on alphabetizing the supply closet, right after I win the lottery.
items.note: Sarcasm: not a real commitment. Pass if the model leaves it out or it scores Ignore.
